# Fallout 76 - Patch notes "Light Water" on June 3rd, 2025 (Patch 60)

![Fallout 76 - Patch notes `Light Water` on June 3rd, 2025 (Patch 60)](/uploads/521_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Slip into your coziest outfit and hit your C.A.M.P. at a quiet pond, because it's time to fish. The contaminated Appalachian waters are now teeming with all sorts of fish of various rarities. Remember: Where you can swim, you can also fish.
## Update highlights

**Leash off** - Head to the moor and start your fishing adventure!
**The Secret of the Axolotls** - An Axolotl can be caught each month in two zones in Appalachia.
**Regional Legends** – Catch big chunks and place them in your C.A.M.P. out of.
**Season 21: Light Waters** - A brand new season of fish-tastic rewards.

Update version 1.7.20.12 and download sizes

**PC (Steam)**: 15GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 32.5 GB
**Xbox**: 32.6GB
**PlayStation**: 8.2GB

## Let go - New quest line

Head to Anglers Ruh, a new location on the moor where your fishing adventure begins. Here you will meet three new characters: the confused Captain Raymond Clark, a mysterious fellow who calls himself "the fisherman", and his pet, a hermit crab named Linda-Lee. During the "Loose the Line" quest series, you will receive a fishing rod so that you can cast the line to any body of water. When looking for a suitable fishing spot, simply follow the following mantra: “If you can swim in a body of water, you can also fish in it.” By the way: The fishing rod does not appear in the Pip-Boy menu because it does not need to be equipped. All you have to do is stand by a body of water and look towards the water for the “Fishing” command to appear on the screen. However, it is available for adaptation to craft workbenches.
### Improve your fishing rod

You can obtain the materials necessary to improve your fishing rod by completing the new fishing challenges and daily fishing quests. In return, you'll receive rewards like new rod styles, floats, and reels that you can use to customize your fishing technique to land the mysterious creatures that live in the wasteland's contaminated waters. Some fish are almost impossible to catch until you upgrade your fishing rod, so don't wait - get out there and complete fishing challenges!
### Catching fish (bait and weather)

Even if you have the nicest fishing rod in all of Appalachia, no fish will bite you without bait. There are three different types of bait you can get, and each of them increases the chances of you hooking rare fish.**Normal bait**You can use this to catch normal fish, as well as salvageable scrap materials and common regional fish. You can buy normal bait from the Fisherman and Captain Raymond Clark in Anglers Rest. They are also a possible reward for completing daily fishing quests.**Improved Lures**With these lures, your chances of catching rarer fish will increase. You cannot buy improved bait from traders, but you can trade them with other players. They can also be obtained from daily fishing quests, public events, and in loot containers throughout the game world.**Premium Lures**These lures offer the best chance of finding very rare fish
